S.FORM: alang Qaljapang ga niya mki sku Tayto Keng atu Taybu go (Dawu), kwara sali buwan nya ga 85 buwan, 223 hi ku kwara s'uli tayan. s'uli tayan pinspngan Gyencumin ga 95% kyan ku 211 hi, binah ga, 'yat kahun sku pinspngan Gyencumin ga 5% kyan ku 12 hi nya. pinspung na linhuyan Gyencumin ga, Paywan 88%, Amis 3%, binah lihuyan s'uli 3%. rhzyal kki'an tay mkyahu' na Qaljapang hya' ga Qu chn.la love vn. tay 'llaw na Qaljapang hya' ga Pangwi. rekisi kayal kyokay maki 1 kyokay. ssquliq pinlpgan ppqbaqan qalang Qaljapang ga ungat pqwasan biru. tuqi 'san basu kisya' glgan spyangan na pinbahu Ubuy qqmayh
S.PHON: alaŋ qaljapaŋ ɣa nija mki [s|ɕ]ku tajto keŋ atu tajβu ɣo *awu kwara [s|ɕ]ali βuwan nja ɣa ** βuwan *** ħi ku kwara [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku *** ħi βinaħ ɣa ʔjat kaħun [s|ɕ]ku pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa * kjan ku ** ħi nja pin[s|ɕ]puŋ na linħujan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa pajwan ** ami[s|ɕ] * βinaħ liħujan [s|ɕ]ʔuli * rħzjal kkiʔan taj mkjaħuʔ na qaljapaŋ ħjaʔ ɣa qu [ʦ|ʨ]ħnla lo*e *n taj ʔllaw na qaljapaŋ ħjaʔ ɣa paŋwi reki[s|ɕ]i kajal kjokaj maki * kjokaj [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq pinlpɣan ppqβaqan qalaŋ qaljapaŋ ɣa uŋat pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru tuqi ʔ[s|ɕ]an βa[s|ɕ]u ki[s|ɕ]jaʔ ɣlɣan [s|ɕ]pjaŋan na pinβaħu uβuj qqmajħ
